competing_hypotheses.claim: The gross 1B XRP escrow release immediately adds 1B XRP to market float and sell pressure.
supporting_evidence: Two 500M EscrowFinish transactions are reported by XRP Insights.
disconfirming_evidence: For hash 33F693..., Whale Alert reports sender and receiver as the same Ripple-labelled owner account.
No exchange deposit or sale is verified.
Net out of escrow is not a circulating-supply metric.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Released XRP remains in Ripple-controlled owner accounts or custody rather than entering external markets.
supporting_evidence: One 500M transaction is rendered with the same Ripple-labelled sender and receiver.
XRP Insights describes EscrowFinish as returning XRP to Ripple's account.
disconfirming_or_missing_evidence: The other 500M destination has not been independently decoded.
No current post-release account balances were retrieved.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Binance's incident recovery creates additional XRP spot/OTC buying demand.
supporting_evidence: Binance says it continues market and OTC purchases for the remaining affected assets.
disconfirming_evidence: Update #4 says XRP is among the top ten assets reported 100% backed.
The remaining 5% is described as outside the top ten.
No XRP-specific purchase quantity or venue is disclosed.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Restored XRP withdrawals may reduce exchange-access friction and venue-specific withdrawal risk.
supporting_evidence: Binance lists XRP in phase one.
CBS/AFP reports Binance said XRP withdrawals were restored by 10:00 UTC.
disconfirming_or_missing_evidence: No successful withdrawal was independently verified.
Binance describes a progressive rollout and possible delays.

red_team_objections: Do not equate gross escrow release or tracker net-out with circulating supply, tradable float, external transfer or sale.
Do not infer the destination of the 3CB037... 500M transaction from the other transaction's same-account pattern.
Do not promote Binance XRP withdrawal status from media-reported available to independently verified without a direct status row or transaction evidence.
Do not convert Binance's 95% aggregate coverage into 95% cash deployed or XRP-specific purchases.
Quarantine the existing 15:45Z Evernorth snapshot at the 15:42:04Z cutoff as future-dated.
